Chapter 253: Chapter 8: Flattening the Demon Saint’s Nest (Please Subscribe) _3

A giant ape, a thousand zhang tall, was madly rushing in this direction.

“The great prince of the Demon Saint’s Nest?”

Lin Yuan immediately recognized the other party.

After all, this demon was extremely famous, known to be a match for the Ancient Saint of Refinement Void, and when it burst forth, it even possessed combat power at the level of an Ancient Saint.

Boom, boom, boom.

The thousand zhang giant ape took huge strides forward.

...

“Where is my Heaven and Earth Spirit Root?”

“Where is my great medicine of this world?”

The thousand zhang giant ape stopped in its tracks, looking around.

With its enormous size, it paid no attention to the valley beneath its feet.

To the giant ape, what they called a valley was nothing but a small mound.

“Huh?”

“Did you steal my Heaven and Earth Spirit Root and the great medicine of this world?”

The thousand zhang giant ape scrutinized carefully and soon spotted a figure as tiny as a speck of dust.

…

In the distance.

Several demonic beasts cautiously observed the thousand zhang giant ape.

“The great prince seems to be in a good mood,” a wolf demon muttered under its breath.

He too was a Demon King of the Mahayana Phase, but in front of the thousand zhang giant ape, he was no different from those Great Demons of the Nascent Soul Stage.

“Some of the Human Race didn’t leave?”

A demon king next to him seemed to have discovered something and looked towards the minute human figure on top of the valley beneath the giant ape’s feet.

“He probably didn’t notice. Too bad, he’s going to die under the great prince’s feet.”

The third demon king said quietly, his tone revealing schadenfreude.

On his way here, the great prince had crushed countless demonic beasts; now, stepping on a human, they only felt much more balanced.

“This human, facing the great prince, is still not running, he might have some strength,” another demon king couldn’t help but say.

“Hmph.”

“What can a bit of strength do?”

“In front of the great prince, if you’re not an Ancient Saint, you’re all just ants,” the wolf demon that started the conversation sneered.

The great prince of the Demon Saint’s Nest represented the strongest combat power just below the Demon Saint.

“That’s true.”

The other demonic beasts nodded one after another.

…

“There is no Spirit Root or great medicine here.”

Lin Yuan stood at the top of the valley and said calmly.

“Liar.”

“I clearly felt the aura of the Spirit Root and great medicine.”

“Was it you who stole my Spirit Root and great medicine?”

The thousand zhang giant ape flew into a rage. Its voice buzzed, rolling like thunder, “Die.”

Following that, the thousand zhang giant ape lifted its right foot and stomped towards Lin Yuan and the valley, intent on crushing them into dust.

…

In the distance.

Several demonic beasts, witnessing this, looked at Lin Yuan as if they were looking at a dead man.

More accurately, none of the demonic beasts’ gazes lingered on Lin Yuan, for in the next moment, he would die under the great prince’s foot.

“The great prince’s stomp leverages the power of heaven and earth, touches upon the mysteries of space, and even if one had the fastest speed, they couldn’t dodge, only endure.”

“Endure the stomp of the great prince? That’s not something a Human Divinity Transformation Stage Heaven Lord could do—only an Ancient Saint’s intervention or life-saving measures of an Ancient Saint’s level such as talismans or magical treasures could save one; otherwise, death is certain,” the demonic beasts quickly discussed.

Their gazes were also observing the great prince’s stomp, seeking to learn something from it.

However, in the next moment.

All the demonic beasts froze.

They saw the towering thousand zhang giant ape suddenly stumble and, unable to help itself, retreat several steps, shaking the ground, opening several enormous fissures.

In the next instant, the thousand zhang giant ape was stomped into the ground by someone.

Under their incredulous gazes.

Lin Yuan, who initially seemed as tiny as a speck of dust, now appeared as a towering giant, stomping the thousand zhang giant ape directly underfoot.

Another stomp, pinning the trying-to-resist giant ape further into the ground.

One more stomp, causing the giant ape to spit out a mouthful of fresh blood as the sound of its bones cracking echoed; it lay bloodied and on the brink of death.

“If it were before…”

But Lin Yuan looked down at the giant ape, as if looking at an insignificant ant, and said calmly, “I have already been to the depths of the Barbarian Wilderness and have flattened the Demon Saint’s Nest.”
